QuestInfo.name: No Looking Back
QuestInfo.0: You reached the Grand Athenaeum. Ask Thales the Librarian if you can browse as you please.
QuestInfo.1: Thales the Librarian says that though all the records are here, they're not available to everyone. He said he can find books for you if you give him a few key words. So, start thinking of some key words.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Thales the Librarian for books about the Black Mage's resurrection, but he said that there are no books on that matter... yet. But he did tell you about a book titled 'The Black Mage and the Five Heroes.' You thought about searching for yourself, but thought better of it.

0.0: I know what you're thinking. Does this place have all the records of this world? Of course! Even the smallest, most pointless details are here. That's what makes this place so special.
0.1: Now, I can't just let you go browsing through freely. I can't just let anyone read about what Chief Stan does when he thinks no one is looking, can I?
0.2: Here's how this works. Give me some #e#rkeywords#k#n about the topic you're interested in, and I'll recommend you books based on that.

yes.0: Let me know your #e#rkeywords#k#n when you're ready.

no.0: Well, you're being stubborn, but I can be more stubborn.

yes.0: (Maybe there are records of me here, if the library truly has ALL the records of the world. I have to keep pressing forward.)
yes.1: (I won't dwell on the past, even if means more pain!)
